why_this_file_exists: The persisted committed endpoints make uniqueness/quality/diversity recoverable over BOTH denominators for the first time. The baseline's published secondary numbers were scored over its emitted set, which excluded 51% of what it committed, so they described the survivors. Reading the two arms side by side without that correction would credit the controller with a uniqueness regression it did not cause and hide the one it did.

over_committed_endpoints.note: the generator's own output, before the task filter; validity is 100% by construction in both arms

over_emitted_samples.note: the published protocol's denominator; a censored or failed attempt counts as an invalid sample

pinned_comparators_motif.provenance: references/reference_metrics.csv @ b50bb3ae, as already pinned in diagnostics/fragment_official_suite_v2/comparison_table.json

readings: MEASURED COST, real and not a denominator artifact: over COMMITTED endpoints uniqueness falls 97.01 -> 76.58 and diversity 0.77 -> 0.60. Both arms use the same denominator here, so this is the controller concentrating growth onto one declared site instead of spreading it over the whole core.
MEASURED GAIN on the same denominator: quality rises 15.87 -> 17.96, so the concentration is not buying task success with worse chemistry.

The baseline's headline uniqueness of 99.81 was an artifact of scoring 8 surviving molecules per 100 attempts. At 83 survivors the same estimator reads 78.22. Do not report that fall as a regression; the comparable pair is the over-committed one.

Both post-control secondary numbers land inside the comparator range rather than outside it (uniqueness 78.22 against GenMol 77.50; diversity 0.60 against GenMol 0.62 and SAFE-GPT 0.56). The baseline's 0.77 diversity came from growing anywhere on the core, including the 59% of endpoints that failed the task.

Quality 14.47 against GenMol 30.10 remains a real gap and attachment control does not close it. It is NOT the placement mechanism: quality is QED>=0.6 AND SA<=4, and this checkpoint's SA is depressed by the small-ring rate documented for the Lineage B preview. Out of scope here, named so it is not mistaken for a controller cost.
